channel.title: HomerView Walkthroughs
channel.description: Spoken walks through HomerView, the browser companion that does what a screen reader cannot. Ten walks, each under five minutes, in the order a new person meets them.
channel.itunes:author: Jamal Mazrui

item.title: 0 - Overview
item.description: Nothing is needed; this walk is listened to. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0-0-overview

item.title: 1 - User Interface
item.description: HomerView is installed. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0a-1-user-interface

item.title: 2 - Install and Launch
item.description: HomerView_setup.exe is downloaded from the HomerView page on GitHub. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0b-2-install-and-launch

item.title: 3 - Read an Article Properly
item.description: HomerView is open on a news article with a lot of navigation around it. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0c-3-read-an-article-properly

item.title: 4 - Decide Whether to Follow a Link
item.description: HomerView is open on a page with links. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0d-4-decide-whether-to-follow-a-link

item.title: 5 - Find Things
item.description: HomerView is open on a page with dates or prices on it. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0e-5-find-things

item.title: 6 - Select and Copy a Passage
item.description: HomerView is open on a long page. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0f-6-select-and-copy-a-passage

item.title: 7 - Gather Files from a Page
item.description: HomerView is open on a page with documents on it, such as an agency's publications. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0g-7-gather-files-from-a-page

item.title: 8 - Check Accessibility
item.description: HomerView is open on a page to check. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0h-8-check-accessibility

item.title: 9 - Conclusion
item.description: Nothing is needed; this walk is listened to. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0i-9-conclusion
